lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-ordered lattice of high-luminance circular spots distributed posterior to the gill region, exhibiting higher spatial density on the mid-flank and becoming more sparse toward the ventral margin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance spots to form a discernible coordinate-like grid across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge running across the upper visible flank, defined by a sharp contrast between high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadowed region on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Series of vertical, reddish-brown linear marks on the mid-lateral flank, indicating localized tissue trauma or parasitic scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three dark, elongated fusiform silhouettes (commensal remoras) attached or swimming directly adjacent to the ventral contour.
